図の例

floe diagram example の 10 種を、名前で描いて spec を見せる（floe-diagram-examples の参照の形）。

architecture

この図の spec
# Architecture: where each piece runs. Nested frames separate the places, and the main flow's edges
# are numbered (1 to 4) for a list under the diagram that explains each step.
#
# Grid: rows centred at y = 92 + 88n (boxes 56 tall, 32 apart). Columns: the agent, the store, the
# server, the browser. Edges between boxes of one row are one horizontal line; an edge between rows
# bends once.
width: 1248
height: 512
title: { en: How floe serves a page, ja: "floe がページを配信する仕組み" }
parts:
  - frame: { x: 272, y: 108, w: 256, h: 300, label: { en: "Store ~/.local/share/floe", ja: "保存先 ~/.local/share/floe" } }
  - frame: { x: 624, y: 20, w: 280, h: 476, label: { en: "Local server 127.0.0.1:7325", ja: "ローカルサーバー 127.0.0.1:7325" }, accent: true }
  - frame: { x: 968, y: 20, w: 264, h: 476, label: { en: Browser, ja: "ブラウザ" } }
  - frame: { x: 984, y: 112, w: 232, h: 188, label: { en: "Frame /a/<slug>/", ja: "外枠 /a/<slug>/" } }
  - box: { x: 24, y: 64, w: 200, h: 56, tone: accent, rows: [[floe publish, main code], { en: run by the agent, ja: "エージェントが実行" }] }
  - box: { x: 288, y: 152, w: 224, h: 56, rows: [["<slug>/source-<id>/", main code], { en: "data file, images", ja: "データファイル・画像" }] }
  - box: { x: 288, y: 240, w: 224, h: 56, rows: [["<slug>/meta.json", main code], { en: "title, description, link", ja: "タイトル・説明・リンク先" }] }
  - box: { x: 288, y: 328, w: 224, h: 56, rows: [{ en: Linked HTML file, ja: "手元の HTML" }, { en: read on every request, ja: "--link で登録・毎回読む" }] }

aws

この図の spec
# AWS architecture: an agent that writes floe pages calls Claude through Amazon Bedrock. Group frames
# (AWS Cloud, a Region) take their icon in the corner; a service is an icon with its name below.
# Every frame of an AWS diagram has square corners. Find icon names with floe icons search <word>.
#
# Grid: icons are 48px and the flow runs along y = 140, through the icons' middles. Contents of a
# frame with an icon start 40 or more below its top. Edges go from the side of one icon to the side
# of the next; edges that part from one point split on a vertical line between the frames.
width: 1000
height: 330
title: { en: How an agent calls Claude through Amazon Bedrock, ja: "エージェントが Amazon Bedrock を通して Claude を呼ぶ構成" }
parts:
  - frame: { x: 16, y: 60, w: 260, h: 200, label: { en: Developer machine, ja: "開発マシン" }, square: true }
  - frame: { x: 316, y: 16, w: 668, h: 300, label: AWS Cloud, icon: aws/group/aws-cloud-logo }
  - frame: { x: 340, y: 72, w: 240, h: 220, label: { en: Region (AWS_REGION), ja: "リージョン（AWS_REGION）" }, icon: aws/group/region }
  - frame: { x: 620, y: 72, w: 344, h: 220, label: { en: Global inference profile, ja: "global 推論プロファイル" }, square: true }
  - icon: { x: 76, y: 116, icon: aws/res/client, label: Claude Code }
  - label: { text: { en: writes floe pages, ja: "floe のページを書く" }, x: 100, y: 202 }
  - icon: { x: 436, y: 116, icon: aws/amazon-bedrock, label: Amazon Bedrock }
  - box: { x: 632, y: 114, w: 320, h: 52, rows: [Opus 5.5, [global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5, sub code]] }
  - box: { x: 632, y: 176, w: 320, h: 52, rows: [Sonnet 5.5, [global.anthropic.claude-sonnet-5-5, sub code]] }
  - box: { x: 632, y: 238, w: 320, h: 52, rows: [Haiku 5.5, [global.anthropic.claude-haiku-5-5, sub code]] }
  - edge: { from: [124, 140], to: [436, 140], label: { en: Inference request, ja: "推論リクエスト" }, at: [200, 140] }
  - edge: { from: [484, 140], to: [632, 140] }
  - edge: { from: [484, 140], via: [[600, 140], [600, 202]], to: [632, 202] }
  - edge: { from: [484, 140], via: [[600, 140], [600, 264]], to: [632, 264] }

class

この図の spec
# Class diagram: the error types of a mistake at a line and column (floe's yamlpos package). Interfaces sit on the top tier; the
# types that implement them share one bent line (the triangle reads as implements), and a diamond
# marks what a type holds. Each table lists only the members the diagram is about.
#
# Grid: table centres at x = 150, 500, 850 (tables 240 wide) and x = 330, 670 for the interfaces;
# tiers start at y = 20 and 168, and the implements lines bend at y = 123, between the tiers.
width: 1000
height: 350
title: { en: "The error types of floe's yamlpos package", ja: "yamlpos パッケージの誤りの型" }
parts:
  - table: { x: 210, y: 20, w: 240, title: error, rows: [[Error(), string]] }
  - table: { x: 550, y: 20, w: 240, title: i18n.Localizer, rows: [[Localize(c), string]] }
  - table: { x: 30, y: 168, w: 240, title: usererr.Error, tone: accent, rows: [[Key, string], [Args, "[]any"], [Conflict, bool], "---", [Error(), string], [Localize(c), string]] }
  - table: { x: 380, y: 168, w: 240, title: yamlpos.Error, tone: accent, rows: [[File, string], [Pos, Pos], [Err, "*usererr.Error"], "---", [Error(), string], [Localize(c), string]] }
  - table: { x: 730, y: 168, w: 240, title: yamlpos.Problems, tone: accent, rows: [[{ en: elements, ja: "要素" }, "*Error"], "---", [Error(), string], [Localize(c), string]] }
  - edge: { from: [150, 168], via: [[150, 123], [330, 123]], to: [330, 78], end: triangle }
  - edge: { from: [150, 168], via: [[150, 123], [670, 123]], to: [670, 78], end: triangle }
  - edge: { from: [500, 168], via: [[500, 123], [330, 123]], to: [330, 78], end: triangle }
  - edge: { from: [500, 168], via: [[500, 123], [670, 123]], to: [670, 78], end: triangle }
  - edge: { from: [850, 168], via: [[850, 123], [330, 123]], to: [330, 78], end: triangle }
  - edge: { from: [850, 168], via: [[850, 123], [670, 123]], to: [670, 78], end: triangle }
  - edge: { from: [380, 253], to: [270, 253], start: diamond, end: none, label: Err, at: [325, 241] }
  - edge: { from: [730, 209], to: [620, 209], start: odiamond, end: none, label: { en: holds, ja: "保持" }, at: [675, 197] }

er

この図の spec
# ER diagram: what floe stores for each page (meta.json). The main entity is in the middle, and each
# relation is one horizontal line at the height of the row it joins.
#
# A row an edge joins has a name ({name, cells}), and the edge ends at it by that name, at the height of
# the row: moving a table or a row moves the edge with it. An edge from no row starts at a point.
# The ends read as how many of this side the other side has: zero-one, zero-many, one.
width: 1060
height: 300
title: { en: What floe stores, ja: "floe が保存するデータ" }
parts:
  - table: { x: 380, y: 40, w: 260, title: { en: Page (meta.json), ja: "ページ（meta.json）" }, tone: accent, rows: [{ name: pageSlug, cells: [slug, PK] }, [title, { en: text, ja: "文字列" }], [description, { en: text, ja: "文字列" }], { name: project, cells: [project, { en: "FK, shown", ja: "FK・表示用" }] }, { name: publishedFrom, cells: [publishedFrom, { en: "FK, owner", ja: "FK・持ち主" }] }, [favorite, { en: bool, ja: "真偽値" }], [createdAt, { en: time, ja: "日時" }], [updatedAt, { en: time, ja: "日時" }]] }
  - table: { x: 40, y: 128, w: 200, title: { en: Project, ja: "プロジェクト" }, rows: [[name, { en: repository, ja: "リポジトリ名" }]] }
  - table: { x: 780, y: 40, w: 240, title: { en: Stored page, ja: "保存したページ" }, rows: [{ name: storedSlug, cells: [slug, { en: "PK, FK", ja: "PK・FK" }] }, [source, { en: the copy, ja: "写しのディレクトリ" }]] }
  - table: { x: 780, y: 172, w: 240, title: { en: Link, ja: "リンク" }, rows: [{ name: linkSlug, cells: [slug, { en: "PK, FK", ja: "PK・FK" }] }, [path, { en: real path, ja: "実体のパス" }]] }
  - edge: { from: [240, 147], to: project, start: zero-one, end: zero-many, label: { en: shown, ja: "表示用" } }
  - edge: { from: [240, 169], to: publishedFrom, start: zero-one, end: zero-many, label: { en: owner, ja: "持ち主" } }
  - edge: { from: pageSlug, to: storedSlug, start: one, end: zero-one, label: { en: stored, ja: "保存時" } }
  - edge: { from: [640, 213], to: linkSlug, start: one, end: zero-one, label: "--link" }

flow

この図の spec
# Decision flow: what floe publish checks. The main path runs down one column, a refusal leaves to
# the right with its reason, and a path that skips checks goes round on the left.
#
# Grid: the main path is centred at x = 300, steps at y = 40 + 76n (boxes 52 tall, 24 apart).
# Reasons start at x = 540. The answer that stays on the main path is a label right of the line.
width: 860
height: 986
title: { en: What floe publish checks, ja: "floe publish の検査" }
parts:
  - box: { x: 200, y: 20, w: 200, h: 40, tone: accent, shape: pill, rows: [["floe publish <file>", main code]] }

git

この図の spec
# Git branches: floe's diagram work, one PR stacked on another. Across is the order of commits; each
# branch has a lane. A branch leaves and joins develop with one slanted line; a dashed one is not
# merged yet, and a hollow dot is a PR in review.
#
# Grid: lanes at y = 50, 110, 170, 230 and commits every 70 from x = 200. A name tag (a pill) ends
# left of where its branch leaves; its width is the name's (13px code, about 8.1px a letter) + 40.
width: 860
height: 260
title: { en: "Stacked branches of floe's diagram work", ja: "フェーズ 2 の積み重ねたブランチ" }
parts:
  - box: { x: 15.3, y: 35, w: 96.7, h: 30, tone: accent, shape: pill, rows: [[develop, main code]] }
  - box: { x: 114, y: 95, w: 202, h: 30, tone: good, shape: pill, rows: [[feature/diagram-spec, main code]] }
  - box: { x: 245.9, y: 155, w: 210.1, h: 30, shape: pill, rows: [[feature/diagram-check, main code]] }
  - box: { x: 297.8, y: 215, w: 218.2, h: 30, shape: pill, rows: [[feature/diagram-render, main code]] }
  - edge: { from: [112, 50], to: [830, 50], bold: true, tone: accent, end: none }
  - edge: { from: [270, 50], via: [[340, 110]], to: [410, 50], straight: true, tone: good, end: none }
  - edge: { from: [410, 50], to: [480, 170], straight: true, end: none }
  - edge: { from: [480, 170], to: [620, 50], straight: true, dashed: true, end: none }
  - edge: { from: [480, 170], via: [[550, 230]], to: [620, 230], straight: true, end: none }
  - edge: { from: [620, 230], to: [760, 50], straight: true, dashed: true, end: none }
  - dot: { cx: 200, cy: 50, tone: accent }
  - dot: { cx: 270, cy: 50, tone: accent }
  - dot: { cx: 410, cy: 50, tone: accent }
  - dot: { cx: 620, cy: 50, tone: accent, hollow: true }
  - dot: { cx: 760, cy: 50, tone: accent, hollow: true }
  - dot: { cx: 340, cy: 110, tone: good }
  - dot: { cx: 480, cy: 170 }
  - dot: { cx: 550, cy: 230 }
  - dot: { cx: 620, cy: 230 }
  - label: { text: "#11", x: 200, y: 30 }
  - label: { text: "#12", x: 270, y: 30 }
  - label: { text: "#13", x: 410, y: 30 }
  - label: { text: { en: "#14 in review", ja: "#14 レビュー中" }, x: 620, y: 30 }
  - label: { text: { en: "#15 stacked", ja: "#15 積み重ね" }, x: 760, y: 30 }

sequence

この図の spec
# Sequence diagram: from floe publish to the open tab reloading. Participants stand in evenly spaced
# columns and time runs down. Answers are dashed, labels sit above their line, and a divider with a
# label marks a change of scene.
#
# Grid: columns 260 apart, a message every 40. Labels are 14 above their line. The band (raw) marks
# where the server keeps comparing versions; a message to the server stops at the band's edge.
width: 1040
height: 700
title: { en: From floe publish to a reload, ja: "floe publish から再読み込みまで" }
parts:
  - box: { x: 15, y: 12, w: 230, h: 52, tone: accent, rows: [{ en: Agent, ja: "エージェント" }, [floe publish, sub code]] }
  - line: { x1: 130, y1: 64, x2: 130, y2: 688, kind: lifeline }
  - box: { x: 275, y: 12, w: 230, h: 52, tone: accent, rows: [{ en: Store, ja: "保存先" }, ["~/.local/share/floe", sub code]] }
  - line: { x1: 390, y1: 64, x2: 390, y2: 688, kind: lifeline }
  - box: { x: 535, y: 12, w: 230, h: 52, tone: accent, rows: [{ en: Server, ja: "サーバー" }, [floe serve, sub code]] }
  - line: { x1: 650, y1: 64, x2: 650, y2: 688, kind: lifeline }
  - box: { x: 795, y: 12, w: 230, h: 52, tone: accent, rows: [{ en: Browser, ja: "ブラウザ" }, [{ en: "the page's tab", ja: "ページのタブ" }, sub]] }
  - line: { x1: 910, y1: 64, x2: 910, y2: 688, kind: lifeline }
  - raw: { svg: "<rect x=\"644\" y=\"420\" width=\"12\" height=\"190\" class=\"band\"/>" }
  - edge: { from: [130, 104], to: [650, 104], label: GET /api/health, at: [390, 90] }
  - edge: { from: [130, 144], to: [650, 144], label: { en: start floe serve if it is stopped, ja: "止まっていれば floe serve を起動" }, at: [390, 130] }

state

この図の spec
# State diagram: floe's server. States stand in one row; a pair of opposite transitions is two
# parallel lines, and transitions from two states to the same one join into one line.
#
# Grid: states centred at y = 120, boxes 200 x 64 and 200 apart (wider than a label). Parallel
# lines are 12 above and below the middle. The start is a dot.
width: 1080
height: 252
title: { en: "The states of floe's server", ja: "floe のサーバーの状態" }
parts:
  - box: { x: 60, y: 88, w: 200, h: 64, shape: state, rows: [{ en: Stopped, ja: "停止中" }, { en: no process, ja: "プロセスなし" }] }
  - box: { x: 460, y: 88, w: 200, h: 64, tone: accent, shape: state, rows: [{ en: Running, ja: "稼働中" }, { en: "on 127.0.0.1:7325", ja: "127.0.0.1:7325 で配信" }] }
  - box: { x: 860, y: 88, w: 200, h: 64, tone: warn, shape: state, rows: [{ en: Outdated, ja: "古い版" }, { en: floe was reinstalled, ja: "floe を入れ直した" }] }
  - dot: { cx: 22, cy: 120 }
  - edge: { from: [29, 120], to: [60, 120] }
  - edge: { from: [110, 88], via: [[110, 58], [210, 58]], to: [210, 88], label: { en: start fails (port in use), ja: "起動失敗（ポート使用中）" }, at: [160, 40] }
  - edge: { from: [260, 120], to: [460, 120], label: { en: publish or serve, ja: "publish・serve" }, at: [360, 102] }
  - edge: { from: [660, 108], to: [860, 108], label: { en: floe reinstalled, ja: "floe を入れ直す" }, at: [760, 90] }
  - edge: { from: [860, 132], to: [660, 132], label: { en: next publish replaces it, ja: "次の publish が入れ替え" }, at: [760, 150] }
  - edge: { from: [960, 152], via: [[960, 216], [160, 216]], to: [160, 152], label: { en: "floe stop, logout or reboot", ja: "floe stop・ログアウト・再起動" }, at: [360, 216] }
  - edge: { from: [560, 152], to: [560, 216], end: none }

# Timeline: when floe's PRs were merged (JST). Across is time; a period is a bar, a milestone is a dot
# on the top row, and the names of the rows stand at the left.
#
# Scale: x = 160 + 16h, h hours from 10/11 0:00 (one day is 384px). The left 160px hold the names.
width: 1100
height: 240
title: { en: "When floe's PRs were merged", ja: "floe の PR がマージされた時期" }
parts:

venn

この図の spec
# Venn diagram: the packages of floe each command runs through. The circles overlap translucently,
# and the text in a region has no background (plain).
#
# Three circles of radius 170 in a triangle, each named. The text of a region says which circles it is in
# (in), and floe places it there, stacking the texts of one region; check with floe diagram inspect.
# The names of the circles stand outside them, at coordinates.
width: 760
height: 520
title: { en: The packages each floe command runs through, ja: "コマンドごとに通るパッケージ" }
parts:
  - circle: { name: publish, cx: 300, cy: 200, r: 170, tone: accent }
  - circle: { name: serve, cx: 460, cy: 200, r: 170, tone: good }
  - circle: { name: render, cx: 380, cy: 335, r: 170, tone: warn }
  - label: { text: floe publish, x: 170, y: 30, plain: true, strong: true }
  - label: { text: floe serve, x: 590, y: 30, plain: true, strong: true }
  - label: { text: floe diagram render, x: 600, y: 490, plain: true, strong: true }
  - label: { text: { en: "cli, i18n", ja: "cli・i18n" }, in: [publish, serve, render], plain: true }
  - label: { text: { en: "usererr, yamlpos", ja: "usererr・yamlpos" }, in: [publish, serve, render], plain: true }
  - label: { text: { en: "diagram, icons", ja: "diagram・icons" }, in: [publish, serve, render], plain: true }
  - label: { text: go-yaml, in: [publish, serve, render], plain: true }
  - label: { text: { en: "store, link", ja: "store・link" }, in: [publish, serve], plain: true }
  - label: { text: { en: "tmpl, daemon", ja: "tmpl・daemon" }, in: [publish, serve], plain: true }
  - label: { text: project, in: [publish], plain: true }
  - label: { text: server, in: [serve], plain: true }
  - label: { text: { en: "page, ui", ja: "page・ui" }, in: [serve], plain: true }
